assertions.evidence: In subscription.py, check_subscription computes and compares the anniversary in code ('anniversary = date(...); if today <= anniversary: return SubscriptionDecision(False, None)') before any model call.

decide_return_intent sends only the cancellation reason as JSON ('{"cancellation_reason": reason}') in messages[1]['content], and the test asserts it equals {'cancellation_reason': 'Back next month'} with no dates sent.

The system prompt asks a noul to classify likely return ('Classify whether the customer's cancellation reason suggests they intend to return... use likely/unlikely/unclear'), while the one-year threshold is enforced in code before calling the model.
